assets.prompt: Use case: precise-character-pose-edit for a live mobile game sprite. Image 1 is the exact approved plush koala toy whose body is hidden inside its felt flower pot (only the head shows). Image 2 is the locked layout guide of the new TALLER 224x300 canvas (44 px added on top; the pot keeps its exact pixels, rim at y=192, feet line at y=256). Image 3 shows the same plush style with an arm coming out of a pot. Draw the koala LEANING OUT OF THE POT TOWARDS THE VIEWER to blow a bubble, like a child leaning out over a window sill: its upper body has come up out of the pot so the plush chest and shoulders are visible above the rim, BOTH SMALL PLUSH PAWS GRIP THE FRONT OF THE POT RIM, and the torso bends forward over the rim towards the camera; shoulders hunched forward, head pushed forward and slightly down, about 15-20 % larger than the ghost head in Image 2 because it is closer to the camera, top of the head and ears a little more visible. Mouth: a clearly puckered round 'O', lips pushed forward, cheeks a little puffed, blowing hard; focused determined eyes looking forward and slightly up, brows lowered a touch (not timid). Keep the exact same character: same blue and cream plush fur, nose, ears and eye style, soft studio light from the upper right, photoreal plush toy render as Image 1. The leaves stay at the rim on both sides of the body (partly covered by the arms is fine). The POT must stay pixel-identical (everything below the red line in Image 2; composite pot-plate-224x300.png), except where the paws and chest pass in front of the rim. Transparent background, nothing above y=6, clean anti-aliased edges, no background shadow, no text, no bubbles, no motion lines.
